chapters.label: The run, live
chapters.text: Napoli against Milan, Champions League. In his own half, a loose ball, and Rafael Leão takes it! Past one, and away he gallops up the left. Inside another, then a burst of speed past the last defender, and across to Giroud... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. In open grass: long strides, ball pushed far ahead. Near a defender: short, quick touches. Then a change of pace, and he rolls it across!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: in open space, take long strides. When defenders get close, switch to short touches!
